title: Decision: wc_static_assert2 on WC_HW_E \!= CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE is correct and must stay
description: The static assert at crypto2dev_port.c:275 guards a subtle semantic invariant: if WC_HW_E == CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (which is -1 on some builds), hardware errors would silently fall through to software, defeating the purpose of the hardware error path. A future contributor might remove the assert as 'redundant' since they are unlikely to have the same value in practice. They are correct that they are unlikely — but the consequence when they are wrong (silent auth bypass on HMAC streaming) is severe. The assert documents the invariant correctly and must stay.
